name: Helping The Poor
overview: Scripture clearly commands believers to generously open their hands to the poor and needy among them, recognizing that poverty will persist in the land (Deuteronomy 15:11). Showing mercy to the poor is not only a reflection of honoring God but also a source of blessing and happiness (Proverbs 14:21, 14:31, 22:9). Those who give to the poor are described as lending to the Lord Himself, with the promise of repayment and provision, while neglect or oppression of the poor brings reproach and curse (Proverbs 19:17, 28:27). This teaching emphasizes a Christ-centered responsibility to care for the vulnerable as an expression of faithfulness to God.
